interactions.label: Talk with Mira
interactions.feedback: Mira asks how your first morning is going. She points out the lecture announcement and mentions a neighborhood post she saw online, though she is not sure what to make of it.

interactions.label: Join Mira's table
interactions.feedback: You sit with Mira and a few classmates as they finish lunch. They compare notes about the morning lecture, and Mira mentions a neighborhood post that has been circulating.

interactions.label: Talk with Noah
interactions.feedback: Noah has just finished his morning drills. He talks about his next class and asks whether you might join a weekend training session.

interactions.label: Talk with Sera
interactions.feedback: Sera asks what you are working on and recommends a quiet desk near the reference shelves. She mentions a few questions she plans to raise during the morning lecture.

interactions.label: Ask about response services
interactions.feedback: Ms. Carter explains that the company verifies reports before dispatching a field team. She gives you a public contact card and advises you not to enter an unsafe building alone.
